purpose: Typography refinement: Apple-style system sans with Claude-style editorial italic serif headings.
prompt:
Edit this existing Rowan 2026 monitor image. Make a TYPOGRAPHY-ONLY refinement. Preserve the exact monitor hardware, thin graphite bezels, soft corners, material finishes, lighting and reflections, wallpaper, blue folded artwork, icons, colors, app/window geometry, panel positions, shared resizing seam, terminal position, all text wording, composition and image dimensions.

Replace the interface typography with Apple's SF Pro visual character: precise contemporary system sans-serif, clean rounded letterforms, natural spacing, quiet medium-weight captions and labels. Apply this to the left app rail, status line, window titles, small document status and body copy. Keep the command-line text monospaced, with an SF Mono-style appearance, preserving the exact commands.

The main document heading “Saad Akhtar” should instead use an elegant Claude-style editorial ITALIC SERIF: sophisticated literary italic letterforms, fine thick/thin stroke contrast, gently bracketed serifs, natural flowing italic angle, warm dark ink. It should look like the distinctive refined italic serif treatment associated with Claude, not a script or handwritten font. Preserve its prominence and approximate size and position. Set the secondary phrase “A personal workspace.” in the same refined italic serif at the smaller existing secondary size and muted color. Keep all remaining document body text in the Apple-style sans-serif, including “Documents, ideas, and things in progress.” and “Make yourself at home.”

The contrast between crisp Apple-style utility text and refined Claude-style italic headings is the only design change. No extra words, labels, ornaments, font specimens, branding, or layouts. Produce one polished finished image.
